one_liner: Linear has a broad GraphQL API with OAuth2 and personal API keys available on the free plan, plus an official hosted MCP server, so a toolkit is ready to build.
auth_notes: Developer docs say to use OAuth 2.0 or personal API keys to authenticate requests. Rate limit table lists API key and OAuth App authentication separately.
access_notes: Linear's own pricing page lists the Free plan at $0 and shows API and webhook access included in the Free plan. MCP access is also included in Free.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Standard rate limits apply, and higher limits can be requested through Linear support.
